name: Peanut Sauce
description: Rich, creamy Vietnamese-style peanut dipping sauce with a savory-sweet balance and a garlicky kick — the classic partner for fresh rice paper rolls.
instructions: Whisk peanut butter, hoisin, soy sauce, and garlic together in a small bowl until combined.
Add warm water 1 tbsp at a time, whisking until the sauce reaches a smooth, pourable consistency.
Stir in rice vinegar and sriracha if using.
Taste and adjust — more water to thin, more hoisin for sweetness, more soy for saltiness.
Transfer to a serving bowl and top with crushed peanuts.
storage: Store in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 1 week. It will thicken when chilled — stir in a splash of warm water before serving.

name: Sweet Chili Sauce
description: A sticky, tangy-sweet Thai-inspired sauce with gentle heat — equally at home as a dip or a glaze.
ingredients: 1 tbsp red chili flakes (or 1-2 finely minced red chilies)
1 tbsp cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp water
instructions: Combine vinegar, sugar, water, garlic, and chili flakes in a small saucepan over medium heat.
Bring to a simmer, stirring until sugar dissolves, about 3 minutes.
Stir in fish sauce.
Add the cornstarch slurry and simmer, stirring constantly, until the sauce thickens and turns glossy, about 2 minutes.
Remove from heat and let cool — it will thicken further as it cools.
storage: Keeps in a sealed jar in the fridge for up to 3 weeks.
wrapPairings: Party Food Sweet and Spicy Sesame Rolls

name: Hoisin Dipping Sauce
description: A thinned, brightened version of hoisin sauce with peanut crunch — deeply savory with a hint of five-spice warmth.
ingredients: 1 tbsp chopped roasted peanuts, for garnish
instructions: Whisk hoisin, rice vinegar, sesame oil, soy sauce, and five-spice powder in a bowl.
Add water gradually until the sauce is a smooth dipping consistency.
Taste and adjust vinegar for tang or water for thickness.
Garnish with chopped peanuts before serving.
storage: Refrigerate in a sealed container for up to 2 weeks.

name: Garlic Chili Sauce
description: A punchy, fiery condiment built on fresh garlic and red chili — great for anyone who wants heat with every bite.
instructions: Pulse chilies and garlic in a food processor until finely minced (or mince by hand).
Transfer to a bowl and stir in rice vinegar, sugar, fish sauce, lime juice, and water.
Stir until sugar fully dissolves.
Let sit for 10 minutes before serving to let the flavors meld.
storage: Keeps refrigerated in a sealed jar for up to 2 weeks.
wrapPairings: Deep-Fried Egg Roll Style Beef Wraps

name: Vietnamese Fish Sauce (Nước Chấm)
description: The essential Vietnamese dipping sauce — a balanced blend of salty, sour, sweet, and spicy that brightens every fresh roll.
instructions: Dissolve sugar in warm water in a small bowl.
Stir in fish sauce and lime juice.
Add minced garlic and sliced chili.
Stir in shredded carrot if using, and let sit 5 minutes before serving so flavors combine.
storage: Refrigerate in a sealed jar for up to 1 week; add fresh garlic and chili if flavor fades.

name: Soy Ginger Dipping Sauce
description: A light, savory sauce with fresh ginger zip and a touch of sesame — pairs especially well with seafood and chicken fillings.
instructions: Whisk soy sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil, grated ginger, and sugar together until sugar dissolves.
Stir in sliced scallion.
Sprinkle with sesame seeds just before serving.
storage: Refrigerate in a sealed container for up to 1 week (scallions are best added fresh each time).

name: Teriyaki Glaze
description: A glossy, sweet-savory Japanese glaze that thickens into a rich coating — brush it on or serve as a dip.
ingredients: 1 tbsp cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp water
instructions: Combine soy sauce, mirin, brown sugar, water, garlic, and ginger in a small saucepan over medium heat.
Bring to a gentle simmer, stirring until sugar dissolves.
Add the cornstarch slurry and cook, stirring, until glossy and thickened, about 2 minutes.
Remove from heat and cool before serving; it will thicken further.
storage: Keeps in a sealed jar in the fridge for up to 3 weeks.
wrapPairings: Party Food Sweet and Spicy Sesame Rolls

name: Honey Garlic Sauce
description: A sticky-sweet sauce built on caramelized garlic and honey, mellowed with soy — a crowd-pleasing all-purpose glaze.
instructions: Melt butter in a small saucepan over medium heat and sauté garlic until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add honey, soy sauce, rice vinegar, and water.
Simmer, stirring, until slightly thickened, about 3-4 minutes.
Stir in red pepper flakes if using, then cool slightly before serving.
storage: Refrigerate in a sealed container for up to 2 weeks; warm gently before serving to loosen.
wrapPairings: Air Fryer BBQ Pulled Pork Rolls
Party Food Sweet and Spicy Sesame Rolls

name: Sriracha Mayo
description: Creamy mayonnaise spiked with sriracha and lime — an instant-classic dip that adds heat and richness to any wrap.
instructions: Whisk mayonnaise, sriracha, lime juice, and garlic powder together in a small bowl.
Stir in sesame oil if using.
Taste and adjust sriracha for desired heat level.
Chill for at least 10 minutes before serving for best flavor.
storage: Refrigerate in a sealed container for up to 2 weeks.

name: Yum Yum Sauce
description: A hibachi-restaurant-style pink sauce — sweet, tangy, and subtly smoky, delicious with just about any filling.
instructions: Whisk mayonnaise and tomato paste together until smooth and pink.
Add rice vinegar, sugar, garlic powder, and smoked paprika; whisk to combine.
Thin with water 1 tbsp at a time to desired consistency.
Chill for at least 30 minutes before serving to let flavors develop.
storage: Refrigerate in a sealed container for up to 2 weeks.

name: Bang Bang Sauce
description: A sweet, creamy, and spicy sauce built on chili sauce and mayo — bold enough to stand up to fried and air-fried wraps.
instructions: Whisk mayonnaise and sweet chili sauce together until smooth.
Add sriracha to taste, along with rice vinegar and honey.
Whisk until fully combined and glossy.
Chill for 15 minutes before serving.
storage: Refrigerate in a sealed container for up to 2 weeks.

name: Homemade Ranch
description: Cool, herby, buttermilk-based ranch — a kid-friendly favorite and a natural match for anything crispy.
ingredients: 1 tsp fresh dill, minced (or 1/4 tsp dried)
instructions: Whisk mayonnaise, sour cream, and buttermilk together until smooth.
Stir in chives, dill, garlic powder, and onion powder.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Refrigerate at least 30 minutes before serving to let flavors meld.
storage: Refrigerate in a sealed container for up to 1 week.
wrapPairings: Low Carb Bacon Ranch Chicken Rolls
High Protein Grilled Chicken Ranch Rolls

name: Blue Cheese Dip
description: A chunky, tangy dip built on real blue cheese — the classic cooling counterpart to buffalo-spiced fillings.
instructions: Whisk mayonnaise, sour cream, and buttermilk together in a bowl.
Fold in crumbled blue cheese, mashing some of it into the base for texture and creaminess.
Stir in garlic powder and lemon juice.
Season with salt and pepper, then chill for at least 30 minutes before serving.
storage: Refrigerate in a sealed container for up to 1 week.
wrapPairings: Party Food Crispy Cauliflower Wing Rolls

name: Garlic Parmesan Sauce
description: A rich, buttery sauce loaded with roasted garlic and real parmesan — an Italian-leaning dip with serious depth.
ingredients: 3 cloves garlic, minced and lightly sautéed
instructions: Sauté minced garlic in melted butter over low heat until fragrant and just golden, about 2 minutes; cool slightly.
Whisk in parmesan and mayonnaise until smooth and creamy.
Stir in chopped parsley and a pinch of salt.
Serve warm or at room temperature.
storage: Refrigerate in a sealed container for up to 5 days; warm gently before serving.

name: Classic BBQ Sauce
description: A smoky-sweet tomato-based barbecue sauce with a tangy backbone — the backbone of every pulled pork or brisket wrap.
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan over medium heat.
Bring to a simmer, stirring occasionally.
Reduce heat to low and simmer 10-15 minutes until thickened and glossy.
Cool before serving or storing.
storage: Refrigerate in a sealed jar for up to 1 month.
wrapPairings: Air Fryer BBQ Pulled Pork Rolls
Party Food Buffalo Chicken Dip Rolls

name: Honey Mustard
description: A simple, versatile sauce balancing sharp mustard with sweet honey — mild enough for kids, punchy enough for adults.
instructions: Whisk Dijon mustard, honey, and mayonnaise together until smooth.
Stir in apple cider vinegar and a pinch of salt.
Taste and adjust — more honey for sweetness, more mustard for tang.
Chill before serving.
storage: Refrigerate in a sealed container for up to 3 weeks.
